headline: Leasing strength tops guidance; full-year outlook raised
summary_short: Total revenue was flat y/y at $425.4M as Same-Store NOI grew 1.4% y/y (4.0% sequentially) on lease rates above the high end of prior guidance; net income per diluted share rose to $0.21 from $0.11 a year ago, while FFO per diluted share held at $0.60 and FFOA at $0.64.
summary_long: Same-Store revenue grew 1.8% y/y (1.4% sequentially) on lease rates above the high end of prior guidance, lifting Same-Store NOI 1.4% y/y and 4.0% q/q with occupancy steady at 96.6%. FFO per diluted share held at $0.60 and FFOA at $0.64, both roughly flat y/y, while net income per diluted share rose to $0.21 from $0.11. UDR repurchased $200.3M of stock, sold a Nashville community for $41.5M gross proceeds, and began paying dividends monthly rather than quarterly. Full-year 2026 guidance was raised for Net Income, FFOA, and Same-Store growth ranges, the FFO range was updated (midpoint down $0.02), and new Q3 2026 guidance was initiated. Total debt was $5.8B at a 3.4% weighted average rate with ~$885M in liquidity.

drivers.explanation: CEO Tom Toomey said 2026 leasing strength is tracking ahead of initial expectations, producing Q2 results that exceeded prior guidance and prompting the full-year guidance raise.
